areas.t: Today and tomorrow, a temperature inversion will confine pollutants near the surface early each day. However, as surface high pressure persists to the northeast, light northwesterly to northerly winds will aid pollutant dispersion each afternoon. As a result, AQI levels will be high-Good on both day
